units.source_text: 冬去春来，一年又过去了。

en.t: Winter passed and spring came, and another year went by.

units.source_text: 一天，夫人对K说：‘今天想玩玩纸牌，你能不能找几个朋友来一起玩。’

en.t: One day, the lady said to K, 'I feel like playing cards today; could you bring a few friends to join us?'

units.source_text: K马上回答：‘我一个朋友也没有。’

en.t: K answered at once, 'I do not have a single friend.'

units.source_text: 夫人听了很惊讶。

en.t: The lady was very surprised to hear this.

units.source_text: 这倒是真的，K没有一个能称得上朋友的人。

en.t: And it was true: K did not have anyone who could really be called a friend.

units.source_text: 在街上碰见打打招呼的朋友倒有几个，不过他们根本不属于能够一起玩纸牌那么熟的朋友。

en.t: He did have a few acquaintances he would greet when he met them in the street, but they were not at all close enough to play cards with.

units.source_text: 夫人又对我说：‘要不你叫几个认识的人来，可以吗？’

en.t: The lady then said to me, 'Then could you invite a few people you know?'

units.source_text: 可是不巧的是，我也没有心思玩这种闹哄哄的游戏，

en.t: But unfortunately I was not in the mood for that sort of noisy game either,

units.source_text: 只含糊其词地应了一声，便把这事给打发了。

en.t: so I merely gave a vague reply and let the matter drop.

units.source_text: 谁知到了晚上，K和我还是被小姐拉出了房间。

en.t: Yet that evening, K and I were still dragged out of our rooms by the young lady.

units.source_text: 尽管没有邀请一个客人来，夫人还是说，那就家里这几个人玩吧，所以倒也没多大动静。

en.t: Although no guests had been invited, the lady said we might as well play with just the people in the house, so it never became much of an event.

units.source_text: 而且一向不沾这类玩意的K，就跟看热闹的人一样。

en.t: Besides, K, who never took part in this kind of amusement, was just like someone watching from the sidelines.

units.source_text: 我问K，你到底知道不知道‘百人一首’里的和歌，

en.t: I asked K whether he actually knew the poems in the Hyakunin Isshu,

units.source_text: 他回答说不大知道。

en.t: and he replied that he did not know them very well.

units.source_text: 小姐听了我的问话，大概是以为我看不起K吧，

en.t: When the young lady heard my question, she probably thought I was looking down on K,

units.source_text: 明显地帮起了K。

en.t: and she began quite openly to take K's side.

units.source_text: 最后发展到两个人几乎联起手来对付我了。

en.t: In the end, the two of them almost joined forces against me.

units.source_text: 要是换了别人，我说不定会跟对方争吵起来。

en.t: If it had been someone else, I might have ended up quarreling with them.

units.source_text: 好在从开始起，K的表情一直没变，

en.t: Fortunately, K's expression had not changed at all from the start,

units.source_text: 我从他脸上没有看出一点得意的表情，

en.t: and I could not see the slightest trace of triumph on his face,

units.source_text: 这才平安无事地把这个游戏对付下来了。

en.t: so I managed to get through the game without incident.
